The official 2026-27 admissions page links the current university-campus catalogue and school brochures. Programme families preserve the exact official programme names in the specialization field where multiple programmes share one award family.
The verified catalogue covers regular university-campus programmes. Affiliated-college and distance-learning portals were not imported because they are separate catalogues.

Some doctoral offerings are stated by school brochures rather than the main 2026-27 campus list and are recorded as programme families where the official brochure does not name individual doctoral specializations.
The university site footer identifies Kalyanpur, Kanpur-208024; district is normalized to Kanpur Nagar for the app.
